credito_sugerido: Source: Monterey County, Big Sur Coast Land Use Plan, 1986
nota: P [1298] (e P [1555], 'about 2.9 million visitors annually'), P [1296], P [1428] e P [1429], relidos. Os 85 % incluem o tráfego militar e a agricultura costeira, e valem 'under improved road conditions and managed traffic'. 85 + 15 = 100. A voz diz 'nearly three million': vale. Protagonista: nenhum número desta cena é do distrito (é a estrada da costa do plano inteira), então nada acende em --destaque no distrito; a fatia das casas (15 %) contra a dos visitantes (85 %).
licenca: fato e citação curta, com atribuição (uso editorial), recriados no visual do canal; a página do plano não vai à tela sem a licença do documento lida (marca/midia.md §7.1; a folha recriada é do pesquisa-documentos)

pedidos.pedido: P [1428]: 'the allocation of limited highway capacity to coastal priority uses' (R154); P [1298]: 'an estimated 2.9 million people visit the Big Sur coast annually'; 'demand is predicted to double over the next 20 to 25 years' (R156, R158); P [1296]: 'the resulting traffic congestion on Highway 1' (R157). P [1428]: '85 percent of the capacity of Highway 1 under improved road conditions and managed traffic shall be reserved' (R223); 'shall be reserved to serve recreational travel, service trips to public and private recreation and visitor-serving facilities' (R159); 'use by military vehicles, and coastal -dependent agriculture' (R160; os 85 % os incluem). P [1429]: 'limit future residential development to a level that will utilize not more than 15 percent of highway capacity at buildout' (R161).
